name: Generic 5-Button Mouse
_comment: Leader-line layout. artworkSize is the DRAWN box in viewBox units (aspect-matched to the 800x1485 PNG: 200x371.25 rounded), kept small so the tall mouse renders compactly — 6 buttons no longer get spread across a 720u-tall box (the old dead-space root cause). ax/ay are the anchor point as a percentage of that box (0-100); side picks the label column.
